info.title: facturac Phase 2 session read API
info.description: Bounded Phase 2 foundation. Session authentication only; no external API credentials or high-risk commands. Use the configured Laravel SESSION_COOKIE; the named scheme documents the .env.example default. UI domain services are reused. Production AGT enablement is unrelated to reading already-known production evidence.

get.description: Explicit tenant/environment; active session membership, verification and MFA required. Unknown query parameters are rejected. No mutation or outbound AGT access. List order is descending internal creation identity. Each result retains its own currency.

get.description: Production context only; homologation returns 403 before master queries. Explicit workspace/entity binding, fresh capability authority and durable audit required. GET/HEAD bodies with input rejected; HEAD performs the same authorization, queries, audit and quota consumption with no response body. No-store. Default active; page 1..10000, per_page 1..50. Literal case-sensitive Unicode substring, no accent folding; customers search name only, catalogue searches grouped name or code. Descending internal identity; offset pagination is not a cross-request snapshot. Unknown parameters rejected. Customer NIF/contact/address/commercial fields excluded. Catalogue base prices only; no stock/negotiated prices or tax certification. Existing session user throttle: 60 requests per minute, shared with document reads.

existingSession.name: facturacao-session
existingSession.description: Existing verified/MFA Laravel web session. Cookie name follows SESSION_COOKIE / APP_NAME in deployment; this example uses .env.example APP_NAME. No new login or credential endpoint.

gross_total_minor.description: Integer minor units in currency_code; no cross-currency aggregate.

issue_status.description: Persisted fiscal status, including legacy status evidence; never rewritten by reads.

agt_status.description: Deprecated legacy workflow summary/provenance (SA1). Persisted submission value, or frozen legacy fallback only without a submission; no evidence-confidence or freshness assurance. Never use as fiscal or receipt authorization. Qualified operational status is internal and is not exposed by v1.

unit_price_minor.description: Exact base supply price in hundredths, maximum 9223372036854775807. No negotiated price, tax inclusion or conversion.

tax_percentage.description: Stored percentage; no repair or AGT validation claim.
